name: Exp_StochasticCGOscillator
summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the StochasticCGOscillator custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable permissions for entry and exit. Position sizing and risk management are handled through the TradeAlgorithms library with multiple margin mode options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于StochasticCGOscillator自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并可配置入场和出场的权限。仓位管理和风险管理通过TradeAlgorithms库实现，支持多种保证金模式。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用StochasticCGOscillator指标作为核心策略引擎，这是一种基于随机指标的改良振荡器，用于捕捉动量变化。入场条件为：当指标线（Ind）从下方穿越信号线（Sign）时产生买入信号，当指标线从上方穿越信号线时产生卖出信号，采用交叉确认机制避免虚假信号。出场条件通过反向交叉信号触发，同时设置了固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），盈亏比为1:2。仓位管理方面，EA支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、自由保证金亏损比例、余额亏损比例和固定手数，默认使用固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制存款份额（默认0.1），但具体计算逻辑依赖外部TradeAlgorithms库。EA仅在新增K线时计算信号（SignalBar=0除外），避免逐tick重复计算，提高了效率。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the StochasticCGOscillator indicator as its core strategy engine, which is a modified stochastic oscillator designed to capture momentum shifts. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator line crosses above the signal line from below, and a sell signal is generated when the indicator line crosses below the signal line from above, using a crossover confirmation mechanism to avoid false signals. Exit conditions are triggered by reverse crossover signals, with fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) providing a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin share, balance share, free margin loss share, balance loss share, and fixed lot, defaulting to fixed lot mode. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1 deposit share), though the actual calculation logic depends on the external TradeAlgorithms library. The EA only recalculates signals on new bars (unless SignalBar=0), avoiding redundant per-tick calculations for improved efficiency.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling risk per trade

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数值检测方法（保证金模式）
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin/balance/margin w/ floating P&L/balance w/ floating P&L/fixed lot

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: Max allowed price deviation (slippage) in points

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰，基于指标交叉信号，易于理解和维护
支持多种仓位管理模式，灵活性较好
设有止损止盈且盈亏比为1:2，风险收益合理
仅在新增K线时计算信号，避免逐tick重复计算，执行效率高
买卖方向可独立控制开仓和平仓权限，便于策略调整
pros_en: Clean and simple strategy logic based on indicator crossover, easy to understand and maintain
Supports multiple position sizing modes offering good flexibility
Has stop loss and take profit with a 1:2 risk-reward ratio, which is reasonable
Signal calculation only on new bars avoids redundant per-tick processing for better efficiency
Buy and sell directions can be independently controlled for entry and exit permissions
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标StochasticCGOscillator和TradeAlgorithms库，缺乏独立性和可移植性
止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未根据市场波动性（如ATR）动态调整
未考虑点差过滤，在大幅波动或高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
默认时间周期为H8，较长周期信号滞后可能导致入场延迟
Recount机制在CopyBuffer失败时仅设标志位，缺乏更健壮的错误处理
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator StochasticCGOscillator and TradeAlgorithms library, reducing portability and independence
Fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are not dynamically adjusted based on market volatility (e.g., ATR)
No spread filter, which may result in unfavorable fills during high spread or volatile conditions
Default H8 timeframe may cause delayed entries due to signal lag on longer periods
Recount mechanism only sets a flag on CopyBuffer failure without more robust error handling
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自适应调整，提高策略适应性
增加点差过滤和最大滑点限制，避免在高点差环境下不利成交
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit for adaptive adjustment to market volatility, improving strategy adaptability
Add spread filter and maximum slippage limits to avoid unfavorable fills in high spread environments

risk_points: 依赖外部库和自定义指标，若缺失则EA无法运行
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性，在极端行情下可能不够灵活
risk_points_en: Dependency on external library and custom indicator means the EA cannot run if they are missing
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not account for market volatility, which may be inflexible in extreme market conditions
